title: Recording Visits Against Adjuster Authorizations on a Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Recording visits against adjuster authorizations

Visits and program days under a Workers' Compensation Referral are recorded against the referral's adjuster authorization on the following terms.

## Status of the referral

A visit or program day is recorded only while the referral is in referral received or active status; only the initial evaluation is recorded in referral received status.

| Referral status | What may be recorded |
|---|---|
| referral received | the initial evaluation only |
| active | visits and program days |
| suspended, discharged or closed | nothing |

## Authorization coverage

Where the program requires adjuster authorization, a date of service after the program's visits allowed before authorization is recorded against an authorization only when an adjuster authorization in force covers that date and still has visits remaining. The visits counted toward that allowance are all visits recorded on the referral over its life.

The judgement rests on the system record of the authorization — its reference, the first and last dates it covers, and the authorized visits still unused on the referral — and the visit is recorded against that authorization's reference.

| Authorization in force covers the date? | Visits remaining? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | recorded against the authorization, drawing one authorized visit |
| yes | no | rendered without authorization |
| no | — | rendered without authorization |

A visit rendered without the required authorization draws nothing, is written off as an unauthorized-visit write-off, and is never billed to the worker while the program does not allow an unauthorized visit to be billed to the worker.

## Extensions and follow-up

An extension is requested once the remaining visits fall to the program's extension trigger or fewer, and no later than the program's extension lead time in calendar days before the authorization end date. A pending authorization request is followed up after the program's follow-up period in business days.

## Employer direct programs

An employer direct program draws its visits from the employer contract up to the program's direct-pay visit cap, after which the injury must be reported as a claim and treated under a new referral.

## Telehealth

Telehealth visits are recorded only where the program allows telehealth.

## The authorization in force

The referral's authorization reference, end date and weekly frequency follow the newest authorization received.
